title: Apple Liquid Glass: content and control layers
summary: Study how a transient control layer relates to stable reading content, with explicit limits on a web teaching approximation.
use_when: An actual Apple-platform app needs native navigation and controls above content; use this web study only to reason about the relationship.
avoid_when: Glass is being added as generic decoration, reading content becomes transient, or CSS blur is being presented as native Liquid Glass.
